description.value: Elysian Coffee Roasters is a Vancouver specialty coffee roaster that sources and roasts its own single-origin beans from Ethiopia, Rwanda, Guatemala, and Colombia, with four neighbourhood cafes across the city. The Kitsilano location at 5th & Burrard sits on West 5th Avenue, a well-known cycling corridor connecting the waterfront to the broader metro network. The brand built its identity around consistent, high-quality espresso and filter coffee, with a stated emphasis on a positive in-cafe work environment.

bike_parking_detail: 9 racks within 100m: wide_stands (2 spaces) at 8m; wide_stands (2 spaces) at 13m; stands (2 spaces) at 29m; stands (4 spaces) at 51m; stands (2 spaces) at 60m; stands (2 spaces) at 62m; wall_loops (9 spaces) at 65m; stands (4 spaces, covered) at 73m; stands (3 spaces, covered) at 75m. Total: 30 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Elysian Coffee Roasters operates four Vancouver cafe locations, including the OSM-listed address at 1778 West 5th Ave (5th & Burrard, Kitsilano). The site is an active e-commerce and cafe brand; however, no mention of bike parking, water refill, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content, leaving all required criteria and most optional amenities as null. The OSM address is corroborated by the website's location listing; the phone number cannot be confirmed as the contact page lists no phone number.
concerns: Website contact page lists no phone number; OSM phone +1-604-734-1778 cannot be confirmed or denied from available website content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Legitimate, active cafe on a heavily cycled Vancouver corridor, but website provides no evidence for any of the three required criteria (bike parking, water refill, washrooms); on-site verification or direct contact is needed before including in the WWC directory.
